address: 320 E. Tennessee St., Tallahassee, FL, 32301, USA
bio: Located in the heart of Tallahassee, this contemporary space from three friends offers a mix of both classic dark leather banquettes and standalone table seating. If the name didn't offer a hint, the menu will soon clue you in — it's all about wild game. The menu rotates often and though there is a clear focus on meat (think grilled Texas antelope), vegetable dishes are far from an afterthought. Start with the chili crunch cauliflower with its crispy breading and garlic-forward citrus sauce. Follow up with the duck confit gnocchi or the wild game meatloaf. To finish, try the flaky and flavorful house-made guava hand pie with goat cheese ice cream.
